item.title: Where to use the blackmarket weapons locker key in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ blackmarket weapons locker key is one of many keys in the extraction mode, and it's used to open, as you may have guessed from its name, a locker that can contain rare weapons and loot. Much like the gun store weapons locker key , however, the blackmarket weapons locker key can be used in two different locations.

item.title: God of War Laufey Hit With Big Delay
item.description: Sony Santa Monica has announced it has made the decision to delay God of War Laufey . The upcoming spinoff game of the iconic PlayStation series was initially slated to be released next February, but players will now have to wait a few extra months to get their hands on it. The studio has set a new release date for the PlayStation 5 exclusive, pushing the game to May 2027.

item.title: Nintendo's Biggest Chip Manufacturer Officially Exits Business
item.description: As players continue to reel from Sony’s announcement that the company will stop producing physical discs for its games starting in 2028, fans of physical media have suffered another blow. It just got a lot harder for Nintendo to produce physical Switch game cartridges.

item.title: Stormlight Archive 6 Gets a Major Official Update From Brandon Sanderson
item.description: Fans of fantasy author Brandon Sanderson are probably familiar with his weekly update videos. These, as the name suggests, are a place for the author to check in with his audience about the state of his numerous ongoing projects, which are visualized through the use of progress bars. In the latest video, Sanderson made the exciting announcement that we will soon see a new progress bar appear. That's because work on the next Stormlight Archive book has begun.

item.title: Star Wars Zero Company’s Hero Is Spiritually Texan, Lead Actor Says
item.description: “Sometimes when I'm very comfortable in the skin of the character I'm playing, [my Texas accent] kind of seeps out,” Jonathan Freeman told Polygon. He voiced the male version of Hawks, the leader of the titular Zero Company. “I thought that it kind of leaned into a bit of the weatheredness of the guy,” he said.

item.title: Walmart Is Having A 'Pokémon' TCG Blow-Out, And It's A Must-See
item.description: It's Walmart Wednesday , the one weekly raffle for collectibles like the Pokémon Trading Card Game and NeeDohs. This Walmart Wednesday is not like the others, though. This week, the retailer is offering a wide range of new, in-demand products — including the Eevee-themed Ultra Premium Collection from Pokémon's 30th Anniversary. In a twist, Walmart's prices are better than both your local card shop and Target.

item.title: Sonic the Hedgehog Officially Returns to Movie Theaters this Christmas
item.description: Across three live-action films, Sonic the Hedgehog has become a bona fide movie star, bringing in more than $1.2 billion at the box office. A fourth Sonic the Hedgehog movie is in the works for 2027, but Sega and Paramount Pictures' moneymaker will make a surprise return to movie theaters well before then. Paramount revealed Sonic's next cinematic outing on Wednesday, with the mascot making a surprise appearance in the second trailer for The Angry Birds Movie 3 .

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero’s Toughest Early Boss Gets Big Nerf in New Update
item.description: Phantom Blade Zero has been off to an impressive start since its October release, shooting to the top of the Steam charts with a massive peak of 833,921 concurrent players. It sold 4 million copies in its first 72 hours , instantly making it one of 2026's best-selling games, even though it was a PS5 console exclusive and hasn't had a physical release yet. Beyond its sales, the wuxia action RPG has been widely praised for its stylish visuals and fun martial arts gameplay .

item.title: Charlie Brown Is Getting a Brand-New Christmas Special, 60 Years After the Original
item.description: In 1965, CBS aired A Charlie Brown Christmas for the very first time. In the 60 years since then, the television special based on Charles M. Schulz's Peanuts comic strip has become one of the most beloved things to watch when winter comes around. While Charlie, Snoopy, and the rest of the gang have had numerous specials since, many involving other holidays , they are returning to celebrate Christmas season once more.

item.title: Prime Video Is Officially Rewriting the Most Important Moment in Lord of the Rings Canon
item.description: The Rings of Power season 3 picks up five years after the fall of the Elven realm of Eregion, and Sauron ( Charlie Vickers ) has made tremendous progress toward conquering Middle-earth. But there's one crucial thing he hasn't accomplished: forging the One Ring. His ultimate goal remains frustratingly beyond his grasp, despite his experience working alongside the elven smith Celebrimbor (Charles Edwards) to forge many of the other rings of power.
